government_outlooks.summary: Canadian Crop Yield Forecast (CCYF) report of the 2026 growing season. The CCYF forecast is based on agroclimatic conditions observed from May 1 to July 31, 2026, and satellite-derived Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) data collected from May 1 to July 26, 2026.
